flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 48, P/B 13.6. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 98% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -1% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management stated they will analyze another quarter and revise their FY27 target after Diwali.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Current capacity utilization is around 55% to 57%, which is sufficient until 2028.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Management noted that the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness resulting from tightening conditions and government appeals regarding gold imports.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "While the wider sector is experiencing a temporary phase of demand softness as a result of this tightening conditions, Sky Gold business model is explicitly built to thrive in such an environment." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)
